trial_court: Family Court, Dumka in Original Suit No. 135 of 2019 and Original Suit No. 118 of 2019
case_name: Mr. Pawan Kumar Das vs Mrs. Fulmuni Marandi
facts_of_case: The parties are Mr. Pawan Kumar Das and Mrs. Fulmuni Marandi. The husband filed two appeals under Section 19 of the Family Courts Act, 1984 against the orders/judgments passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Dumka in Original Suit No. 135 of 2019 and Original Suit No. 118 of 2019.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: It has been submitted that the issue of cruelty has not been taken into consideration in right perspective even though the fact about the same as also the fact of living separately has well been established.

legal_principles.principle: A court must properly consider the factual aspects and evidence adduced by the parties.
legal_principles.held: It has been contended on behalf of the appellant/petitioner that the factual aspect which was available before the learned court supported by the evidences adduced on behalf of the appellant/plaintiff has not properly been considered

outcome.final_order: The appeal is directed against the order/judgment passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Dumka in Original Suit No. 135 of 2019 and Original Suit No. 118 of 2019.
